items.evidence: A title: 'Scheduled, Charter & Cargo Flights throughout Alaska - Grant Aviation, Alaska, Flights - Grant Aviation'; B title: 'Grant Aviation

items.text: The H2 sizes and weights differ. A's H2s are 30px at weight 400. B's H2s are 22.4px at weight 700.
The accent red differs. A uses a brighter red, rgb(210,60,51). B uses a darker rust red, rgb(181,65,44).

features.statement: Page title is short, in the form 'brand – tagline', rather than a long keyword-stuffed string.
Uses a full set of semantic landmarks (main, aside, article, time, several sections) and nested heading hierarchy (h3 under h2).
Headings use a Georgia-style serif face while body text uses the system-ui font stack.
H1 is short title-case brand text, with the tagline moved to a separate paragraph and a small eyebrow line above.
H2 headings are small (about 22px) and bold at weight 700, giving modest heading scale.
Accent color is a muted, darker rust red used for buttons and CTA bands, on cream and black backgrounds.
Header uses a compact small logo in a rounded colored tile beside a bold text brand label.
Header phone number appears as a filled accent-colored pill button in the navigation.
Hero is a two-column grid with headline on the left and a form card on the right.
Cards are cream or white with rounded corners and soft shadows, wrapping content groups.
Form uses native controls (selects, date inputs, radios) with sentence-case labels, explicit label elements and helpful placeholders.
Primary buttons have an 8px radius and generous padding in the accent color.
Secondary links, such as agent login, are centered under the main button and underlined.
Notices appear as white cards with an accent-colored left border and an accent-colored heading.
Quick links are plain outlined text-only buttons on a dark band, without icons.
Sections are full-width color bands without a boxed, shadowed wrapper.
Contact details are shown as short link text such as 'Email us' rather than raw addresses or URLs, and long headings keep numbers in separate text.
Footer has multiple columns with small letter-spaced uppercase headings, and a gray copyright line below a hairline in the same dark footer.
Hero background artwork is heavily darkened so it reads as a dim backdrop behind the text.
Page is lightweight, with minimal images, few scripts, minimal metadata and lean markup with few classes.
Social content is reduced to a single inline link, and news is shown as simple dated article columns with top rules.
